title: "Firearm Purchase Demand Analysis"
output: html_document
runtime: shiny
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

```{r}
library(shiny)
library(dplyr)
library(plotly)
library(readr)
library(zoo)
library(lubridate)
```


```{r}
#State-Level Firearm Demand Analysis: Growth, Trends, and Composition — Interactive Dashboard
#-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# DATA SOURCE : FBI National Instant Criminal Background Check System (NICS)
# DATASET     : nics-checks-last-five-years.csv (Jan 2019 – Sep 2023)
# STRUCTURE   : 3,135 rows × 27 columns. Each row = one state × one month.
# Dashboard Components:
# 1. Left map  — Average monthly growth rate (short-term change)
# 2. Right map — Regression slope (within-year trend direction)
# 3. Bar chart — Category composition for any selected state from maps
  
# Analytical Approach:
# I have used 'demand_checks' (handgun + long_gun + multiple + permit + other)
# instead of raw 'totals' because 'totals' includes permit_recheck, admin, pre-pawn, return etc
# they are not consistently reported across the states and also
# does not represent any new firearm acquirement or purchase.
  
# Data Loading
  
df <- read_csv("nics-firearm-background-checks.csv")

territories <- c("Guam", "Mariana Islands", "Puerto Rico", "Virgin Islands")
df <- df %>% filter(!state %in% territories)

# Data Cleaning and Preparation 
df$month <- as.yearmon(df$month)
df$year  <- format(df$month, "%Y")
df <- df %>% filter(year %in% c("2019","2020","2021","2022","2023"))
df <- df %>% arrange(state, month)


# Firearm Demand Check - Key metric used
df <- df %>%
  mutate(demand_checks = handgun + long_gun + multiple + permit + other)

# Calculating Growth Rate Month-Over-Month 
df <- df %>%
  group_by(state) %>%
  mutate(growth = ifelse(lag(demand_checks) > 0,
                       (demand_checks - lag(demand_checks)) / lag(demand_checks),
                       NA))
```




```{r}
# Regression slope per state per year
df <- df %>%
  arrange(state, year, month)

slopes <- df %>%
  group_by(state, year) %>%
  mutate(time_in_year = row_number()) %>%   
  do({
    if(nrow(.) > 1){
      model <- lm(demand_checks ~ time_in_year, data = .)
      data.frame(slope = coef(model)[2])
    } else {
      data.frame(slope = NA)
    }
  })


# Aggregate to Year Level
#growth = mean of all valid monthly growth rates in that year

state_year <- df %>%
  group_by(state, year) %>%
  summarise(growth = mean(growth, na.rm=TRUE),
    handgun = sum(handgun),
    long_gun = sum(long_gun),
    multiple = sum(multiple),
    permit = sum(permit),
    other = sum(other),
    totals = sum(totals)
  ) %>%
  left_join(slopes, by=c("state","year"))

# Category Shares
# Each share = category count/totals

state_year <- state_year %>%
  mutate(handgun_share = handgun/totals,
    longgun_share = long_gun/totals,
    multiple_share = multiple/totals,
    permit_share = permit/totals,
    other_share = other/totals)

```



```{r}

# State Postal Codes required for  USA choropleth mapping

state_codes <- c("Alabama"="AL","Alaska"="AK","Arizona"="AZ","Arkansas"="AR",
  "California"="CA","Colorado"="CO","Connecticut"="CT","Delaware"="DE",
  "Florida"="FL","Georgia"="GA","Hawaii"="HI","Idaho"="ID",
  "Illinois"="IL","Indiana"="IN","Iowa"="IA","Kansas"="KS",
  "Kentucky"="KY","Louisiana"="LA","Maine"="ME","Maryland"="MD",
  "Massachusetts"="MA","Michigan"="MI","Minnesota"="MN","Mississippi"="MS",
  "Missouri"="MO","Montana"="MT","Nebraska"="NE","Nevada"="NV",
  "New Hampshire"="NH","New Jersey"="NJ","New Mexico"="NM","New York"="NY",
  "North Carolina"="NC","North Dakota"="ND","Ohio"="OH","Oklahoma"="OK",
  "Oregon"="OR","Pennsylvania"="PA","Rhode Island"="RI","South Carolina"="SC",
  "South Dakota"="SD","Tennessee"="TN","Texas"="TX","Utah"="UT",
  "Vermont"="VT","Virginia"="VA","Washington"="WA","West Virginia"="WV",
  "Wisconsin"="WI","Wyoming"="WY")

state_year$code <- state_codes[state_year$state]

```



```{r, echo=FALSE}
library(plotly)
# User Interface (UI)

ui <- fluidPage(
  
  tags$head(
  tags$style(HTML("
    html, body, .container-fluid {
      min-height: 100vh;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
    }
  "))
),
titlePanel("State-Level Firearm Demand Analysis: Growth, Trends, and Composition"),
  
#Year selection
  fluidRow(column(3,
      selectInput("year", "Select Year:",
                  choices  = sort(unique(state_year$year)),
                  selected = "2019", width    = "100%"))
  ),
#maps side by side  
  fluidRow(
    column(6, plotlyOutput("growth_map", height = "320px", width = "540px")),
    column(6, plotlyOutput("slope_map",  height = "320px", width = "540px"))
  ),
#Composition bar chart
  fluidRow(
    column(12, plotlyOutput("bar_chart", height = "280px", width = "580px"))
  )
)

#Server section
#-----------------------------

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  
  selected_state <- reactiveVal("California")
  
  # MAP 1 — Average Monthly Growth Rate
  # Filter to only the rows matching the selected year
  output$growth_map <- renderPlotly({
    data <- state_year %>% filter(year == input$year)
    plot_ly(data, source = "growth_click") %>%
      add_trace(z = ~growth, zmid = 0,
        locations = ~code, locationmode = "USA-states",
        type = "choropleth", 
        colors = "RdBu",
        text = ~state,
        hovertemplate = paste("<b>%{text}</b><br>",
                              "Growth: %{z:.3f}<br>",
                              "<extra></extra>"),
        key = ~state
      ) %>%
      layout(title = "Avg Monthly Growth (Within-Year)",
             geo  = list(scope = "usa"))
  })
  
  # MAP 2 — Regression Slope
  output$slope_map <- renderPlotly({
    data <- state_year %>% filter(year == input$year)
    plot_ly(data, source = "slope_click") %>%
      add_trace(z = ~slope, zmid = 0,
        locations = ~code,
        locationmode  = "USA-states",
        type  = "choropleth", 
        colors = c("#440154", "#9ACD32", "#ffff00"),
        text = ~state,
        hovertemplate = paste("<b>%{text}</b><br>",
                              "Slope: %{z:.1f}<br>",
                              "<extra></extra>"),
        key = ~state
      ) %>%
      layout(title = "Within-Year Trend (Slope)", geo = list(scope = "usa"))
  })
  
  #State selection in growth map click
  observeEvent(event_data("plotly_click", source = "growth_click"), {
    click <- event_data("plotly_click", source = "growth_click")
    if (!is.null(click$key)) selected_state(click$key)
  })
  
  #State selection in slope map click
  observeEvent(event_data("plotly_click", source = "slope_click"), {
    click <- event_data("plotly_click", source = "slope_click")
    if (!is.null(click$key)) selected_state(click$key)
  })

  # Categorical Bar Chart
  output$bar_chart <- renderPlotly({
    st   <- selected_state()
    data <- state_year %>% filter(state == st, year == input$year)
    if (nrow(data) == 0) return(NULL)
    plot_ly(x = c(data$handgun_share, data$longgun_share,
            data$multiple_share, data$permit_share, data$other_share),
      y = c("Handgun", "Long Gun", "Multiple", "Permit", "Other"),
      type = "bar", orientation = "h"
    ) %>%
      layout(title = paste("Category Breakdown —", st), xaxis = list(tickformat = ".0%"))
  })
}


```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server, options = list(height = 1100))
```
